verdict.rationale: Munito AI's first-party docs list integration guides for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Hermes) and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex). These sit on top of OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs that switch over with a base URL, key and model ID change. missing for 10: the contents and depth of the individual guides are not shown (only index-level mentions), and there is no independent or hands-on confirmation that these integrations work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the provider into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, first-party integration guides

citations.quote: Connect Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Hermes, or an iOS client.
Move from the OpenAI or Anthropic SDK. Change the base URL, the key and the model ID.
